svg.aria-label: Hi, I'm Kasundi Ranaweera — Computer Science Undergraduate, Full-Stack Developer, AI/ML & Data Science Enthusiast. I'm a BSc (Hons) Computer Science undergraduate at NSBM Green University, affiliated with the University of Plymouth. I'm passionate about building meaningful digital experiences and turning ideas into reality through technology. Interests: Full-Stack Development, Data Analytics, Machine Learning, AI & LLMs. Learning: System Design, Software Architecture, Automated Testing, CI/CD. Research Interests: NLP, AI for Low-Resource Languages. Goal: Building impactful software solutions and continuously growing as a developer.. Open to: Software Engineering, Data Analytics, Machine Learning Internships. Building, learning, and innovating.
